cash_grow.why: Ruling 63 (00-rulings.md section K): a door's Bite never falls as its Reach grows and a cash-out is never worth less than the plain action it replaces, so the door has ONE Bite and its own compounding step. Its two anchors cannot both be met with any step of at least 1 (the skill-10 Reach over the skill-1 Reach is already more than the anchors' ratio), so every unit is worth the same (step 1) and the Bite is fitted to the skill-10 worth; the skill-1 worth follows (at_1_follows) and stays over one plain action plus a quarter a unit.

worth.shape: ruling 63: one Bite (1.25) on the door's own step 1.0; nothing a player holds is ever worth less, and a part-filled cash-out is never under one plain action plus a quarter a unit
